title: Kissinger on the 303 Committee overseeing covert operations

tellings.quote: The 303 committee was a secret US inter agency group that oversaw all covert operations and Kissinger was involved with it.

plain: The 303 Committee was a secret US group, drawn from several agencies, that oversaw all covert operations, and the statesman Henry Kissinger was part of it, says Jesse Michels. Michels lays this out himself, without naming a source, in an episode asking whether Kissinger oversaw a program to recover crashed UFOs. If so, Kissinger would have sat where such a secret program could be run.
